{{Quote|I'm going to be completely honest with you about something. Minn is having trouble grasping it, but I hope you will understand. A formal partnership with the Republic isn't popular here. We've tried this route before--many times. It never ends well for us. It's going to take a lot of effort on your part to get everyone to come around.|[[Wo Kasto]], to the [[Alliance Commander]]|<ref name="TOR:EttW">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=faction|Republic|Ear to the Water|Manaan}}</ref>}}
The '''Manaan Incorporation Project''' was a diplomatic effort undertook by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] of [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] to conclude an alliance between the two entities following the [[Invasion of Manaan|invasion of Manaan]] by the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:MIC">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=other|Reputation: "Manaan Incorporation Project"}}</ref> Two prominent figures of the project were [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Wo Kasto]] of the [[Manaan Special Warfare Group]] and [[Minn Ishkah]] of the [[Republic Diplomatic Corps/Legends|Republic Diplomatic Corps]].<ref name="TOR:UC">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=faction|Republic|Uncertain Cooperation|Manaan}}</ref>
